customConnectors.title: My custom connectors
customConnectors.hint: Create your own simple REST connector and submit it for Platform Admin review before it can be used — it always stays private to your workspace.
customConnectors.policyNote: Only NONE/API_KEY/BEARER_TOKEN/BASIC auth and a public HTTPS URL are allowed — no OAuth2, and no reserved capabilities (platform./security./admin./permissions.*).
customConnectors.webhookPolicyNote: Only HMAC or HEADER_TOKEN authentication is allowed, and the event type must be one of a fixed, safe list.
